senses.gloss: (b. h.; v. סוּם) to place, put, appoint, make.
units: <cite ref="Berakhot 39b:7">Ber. 39ᵇ</cite> <he>ששַׂמְתָּ שלום וכ׳</he> thou hast made peace between the scholars. Mekh. B’shall. introd. <he>במקום הזה שָׂמוּהוּ</he> in this place they (the Egyptians) have put him (Joseph).

<cite ref="Berakhot 28b:5">Ber. 28ᵇ</cite> <he>מודה</he> … <he>ששמת חלקי וכ׳</he> I thank thee, O Lord, that thou hast appointed my lot to be with those who sit in the school-house, and not with those who abide at the corners (idlers); a. fr.
<cite ref="Berakhot 16b:18">Ber. 16ᵇ</cite> <he>ותָשִׂים חלקנו וכ׳</he> and that thou mayest place our lot in paradise.
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 99b:10">Snh. 99ᵇ</cite> <he>כל העוסק … משים שלום וכ׳</he> whosoever is engaged in the study of the Law for its own sake, causes peace to reign &c.; a. e.
